def transform(grid):
    """Rotate the grid 180 degrees, then mirror-tile it 3x3 across both axes."""
    transposed = [list(row) for row in grid[::-1]][:]
    transposed = [row[::-1] for row in transposed]
    h, w = len(transposed), len(transposed[0])
    row_indices = list(range(h)) + list(range(h - 1, -1, -1)) + list(range(h))
    col_indices = list(range(w)) + list(range(w - 1, -1, -1)) + list(range(w))
    return [[transposed[r][c] for c in col_indices] for r in row_indices]
